Autumn Tale
Autumn Tale is a 1998 French film, directed by Éric Rohmer, starring Béatrice Romand, Marie Rivière, Alain Libolt, Didier Sandre, Alexia Portal, and Aurélia Alcaïs. It is the final film of Rohmer's" Contes des quatre saisons"( Tales of the Four Seasons), which also includes" A Tale of Springtime"( 1990)," A Tale of Winter"( 1992) and" A Summer's Tale"( 1996).
